name: hexagon-pattern
title: Hexagon Pattern
description: A background hexagon pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the SVG. Outlines use `stroke-*`, filled hexagons use `fill-*`.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of each hexagon (centre to vertex) in pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Spacing in pixels between neighbouring hexagons.

props.name: x
props.description: Horizontal offset of the pattern in pixels.

props.name: y
props.description: Vertical offset of the pattern in pixels.

props.name: direction
props.description: horizontal: flat-top hexagons. vertical: pointy-top hexagons.

props.name: strokeDasharray
props.description: SVG stroke-dasharray of the outlines, e.g. "4 2" for dashes.
